title: Balanced Freekeh 'Risotto'
subtitle: with Spring Greens and Parmesan
description: Wholesome, nutty freekeh is the star of this sublime spin on risotto. Crisp sugar snaps and tender baby spinach dial up the nutrition and bring vibrant pops of green.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Finely chop the onion. Trim the stems from the sugar snap peas, removing the strings from one side. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Pick the dill fronds, discarding the stems. Finely grate the parmesan. Crumble 1 stock cube into a heatproof jug, add 350ml boiling water and stir to dissolve.
Soften onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, garlic and dill, stirring, for 3 mins or until the onion is softened.

Cook freekeh: Add the freekeh to the pan and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the grains are well coated. Add the stock, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 18 mins or until most of the liquid is absorbed and the freekeh is almost tender.

Add veggies: Stir the sugar snap peas into the freekeh mixture and cook for 2 mins or until the sugar snap peas are tender. Stir in the spinach and half the parmesan. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the freekeh 'risotto' among bowls and sprinkle with the remaining parmesan. Enjoy!

Did you know?: This is a healthy take on risotto using freekeh instead of the usual rice. Freekeh is a type of wheat that’s harvested while still green and then roasted. Nutty and slightly chewy, it adds a bit of bite to this traditionally creamy dish.
